description: Tag corpus for the subject + action redesign. Each case expects a subject tag, an action tag, an optional duration and a policy outcome. Expected values are the correct product behaviour, not what any model or resolver currently does. Test infrastructure only.

empty.description: No subject or action tags at all (first use of the app).
